content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Manchester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree and have led projects for several years. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you document your background and confirm readiness before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Manchester-focused cohorts meet synchronously, combining interactive lectures, real-world case studies, and Q&A sessions. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, risk management, and exam-tested domains over the course of intensive weeks.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, apply directly to PMI through their official portal. You'll document your education and project experience, then pay PMI's exam fee. Our team provides step-by-step guidance to ensure your application meets all PMI standards and avoids delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, strategy sessions, and one-on-one coaching—to strengthen weak areas. You'll sit for the proctored PMP exam on a schedule that works for your timeline. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing workshops, webinars, and recertification courses that count toward your PDU requirement, helping you stay current in Manchester's competitive project-management market.
